messages:
Jordan Patel: transferring StrataWave to CS — signed yesterday, cc'ing Maya. quick summary: $120k ARR, 10-seat pilot, target go-live 2026-04-15. they require PII isolation and prefer Dedicated.
Maya Liu: thanks Jordan — welcome onboard StrataWave team. can you drop the contract PDF and the SSO contact?
Jordan Patel: contract in Salesforce link: https://sf.example/opp/12345 (internal). SSO contact is elena@stratawave.com. they asked for SAML + SCIM.
Maya Liu: noted. initial kickoff: next Wed 2026-03-26 10am PT. I'll send invite. main risks: SSO timeline (customer side), and dataset upload — they want bulk ingest of existing transcripts.
Lucy Ramirez: tagging support — need to provision API keys and a test org. any dedicated pool sizing recs?
Sanjay Reddy: Dedicated sizing: start with 2x A100-equivalents for pilot (100k monthly tokens expected). If they enable realtime chat at scale we should auto-burst. I can provision trial capacity in staging. ping me when prod window is locked.
Maya Liu: action items: 1) SSO + SCIM handshake (owner: Jordan) 2) Provision test org & API keys (owner: Lucy) 3) Pilot capacity staged (owner: Sanjay) 4) Upload/ingest format doc + sample data (owner: StrataWave + Maya) 5) Kickoff + runbook review (owner: Maya)
Jordan Patel: I emailed Elena asking for SSO metadata; cc'd Maya. also sent sample payment schedule to finance.
Lucy Ramirez: creating support ticket for test org + API keys: ticket #SUP-4782. ops-bot created it.
ops-bot: Support ticket SUP-4782 created by Lucy Ramirez for StrataWave; assignee: support-oncall.
Maya Liu: also flagging renewal risk: currently low given expansion potential, but if SSO or ingest slips >3 weeks we should mark "at-risk" for onboarding timeline.
Jordan Patel: agreed. I'll escalate SSO if no response by EOD Fri.
Sanjay Reddy: note on private data handling: recommend customer use VPC peering + KMS integration. I'll open infra PR for onboarding docs.
Maya Liu: final checklist before kickoff: - SSO metadata received - test org provisioned & API keys validated - sample data uploaded to staging - pilot capacity reserved - kickoff calendar invite sent
Lucy Ramirez: test org creds will be in LastPass shared folder once SUP-4782 validated.
Maya Liu: thanks team — I'll update the CS onboarding doc and post the invite. tagging owners here: @Jordan Patel, @Lucy Ramirez, @Sanjay Reddy. we'll reconvene in this thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: great — will follow up on SSO.
Maya Liu: closing notes: please add any blockers in-thread. otherwise I'll publish runbook and next-steps doc by EOD tomorrow.
